results.name: Mobile Home
results.description:
You approach the great ravine with intention to cross to the other side… There you see a something strange!  Giant metallic arms lift up an entire building and carry it towards you! Customs official who lives in a Mobile Home greets you and asks for a toll. As soon as you hand over the money - she invites you on board. “Welcome to house of between” - she says and smiles. She looks into a distance and frowns "Some stay here forever".

This animated scene was modelled in Blender 3.0 in a style I call STEAMPUNK CHINESE GOTHIC based on the assets I am creating for Unreal Engine 4 (Steampunk Town). Hope you like it!

results.name: The Thinker by Auguste Rodin
results.description:
The Thinker (French: Le Penseur) is a bronze sculpture by Auguste Rodin.
Rodin first conceived the figure as part of his work The Gates of Hell commissioned in 1880, but the first of the familiar monumental bronze castings did not appear until 1904.
A bronze cast of the sculpture can be found in the garden of the Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek in Copenhagen.
The museum has a unique Rodin collection with a total of 34 sculptures, commissioned directly from the artist himself in the years 1900-1914, including well-known and monumental works.

3D scanned in 2017 using Photogrammetry from about 700 images.

![](https://rigsters.com/sketchfab_img/thinker-rodin-3D-scan-rigsters.jpg)

results.name: Dragon Gate Inn with Neon
results.description:
Inspired by a best 1967 Taiwanese film, "Dragon Gate Inn". The whole plot is a variant of "a guy walks into a bar". As a sandstorm threatens and drives most travellers away, a few groups driven by different agendas are determined to stay in the desert at the famous Dragons Gate Inn. Amidst rumors of an ancient city and with Zhao Huai'an and the leader of the West Bureau approaching, events are about to unfold with the Dragons Gate Inn as the stage for an all out clash.

Credit: All Texture from FreePik Website.
